mapper.select: SELECT ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'HOSPITAL' THEN 1 END) AS hospital_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'PHARMACY' THEN 1 END) AS pharmacy_count FROM admin_dongs ad LEFT JOIN places p ON p.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id AND p.category IN ('HOSPITAL', 'PHARMACY') GROUP BY ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area
